analysis.summary: A tenant eviction dispute arising in Mumbai involving the rights and obligations of a landlord and tenant. The matter likely concerns grounds for eviction, tenancy termination, and applicable rent control legislation in Maharashtra. The dispute may involve issues of possession, arrears of rent, or unauthorized occupation.

issues.issue: Grounds for eviction of tenant and validity of eviction notice
Termination of tenancy and requirement of notice to quit
Recovery of possession and execution of eviction decree
issues.governing_law: Code of Civil Procedure 1908, Order 21 Rule 35

issues.issue: Tenant's right to protection against arbitrary eviction under rent control legislation

multi_match.query: Maharashtra Rent Control Act eviction notice quit

plan.esql: FROM legal-judgments | WHERE text LIKE '*eviction*' AND (text LIKE '*Maharashtra Rent Control*' OR text LIKE '*tenant*' OR text LIKE '*Mumbai*') | KEEP title, headline, catchwords, text | LIMIT 10
plan.search_rationale: The query blends multi_match across title, headline, catchwords, and text fields to surface judgments discussing tenant eviction in Mumbai, while term and match boosts on 'Maharashtra Rent Control Act 1999' and 'Transfer of Property Act Section 106' ensure the most jurisdictionally and statutorily relevant precedents are ranked highest.
